source_text:
συνόδου τῆς ἐν τῇ Νικαέων πόλει τῆς Βιθυνίας ἐχόμενα τῇ ἡμετέρᾳ ἀποστεῖλαι
ἀγάπῃ, ὅπερ 424 καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησιαστικῇ ἱστορίᾳ ζητοῦντες εὑρήσετε.
Περὶ δὲ τοῦ πάσχα, ὡς ἐγράψατε, ἀγγέλλομεν ὑμῖν τῇ πρὸ δεκαεπτὰ
καλανδῶν μαΐων ἡμᾶς ἐπιτελέσοντας τῇ ἐπεισερχομένῃ ἰνδικτιῶνι. Ἡ ὑπογραφή. Ὁ
θεὸς καὶ ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν τὴν ἁγίαν ὑμῶν σύνοδον φυλάξοι, ὅπερ εὐχόμεθα,
τιμιώτατοι ἀδελφοί.
pass_a_gloss: End of the long sentence: the dependable Nicene transcript travels stitched to Cyril’s affectionate covering letter, and the same material can be checked in the church historian’s pages. Easter notice: answering their written query, Alexandria declares it will observe the feast on the seventeenth day before May’s kalends in the next indiction cycle. Closing signature line: a prayer that God and the Lord will protect the Carthaginian synod.
pass_b_english: synod in the city of Nicaea in Bithynia, bound together with this my loving letter — which you will also find by searching in the church history.
But concerning Easter, as you wrote, we announce to you that we shall celebrate it on the seventeenth day before the kalends of May in the coming indiction.
The subscription. May God and our Lord guard your holy synod, as we pray, most honored brothers.

choices.choice: Bound with my loving letter: charity as the covering letter itself.
Seventeenth before May’s kalends left in ancient form; the equation to April 15 is not in the source.
Continues the sentence begun in ep-rem-mid.
